meta.title: Juan Ignacio Maraude | Web Development & E-commerce
meta.description: Frontend developer focused on e-commerce. I build online stores, landing pages and custom web systems with React, Next.js and Tiendanube, and I also manage Meta Ads and measurement.
meta.ogImageAlt: Juan Ignacio Maraude, web development and e-commerce

title.label: Juan Ignacio Maraude
title.h2: I build online stores and websites with React, Next.js and Tiendanube. I also manage Meta Ads and tracking, so I understand both the code and the numbers behind it.

about.label: About Me
about.photoAlt: Portrait of Juan Ignacio Maraude, web developer
about.heading: 4 years building for the web, focused on e-commerce
about.p1: I have 4 years of coding experience, focused on the frontend of online stores and websites. I work with React, Next.js and Tiendanube, and I have built e-commerce projects like Market on Demand and Vesta Elemento, plus the institutional site for MACASA Desarrollos.
about.p2: I also work at a marketing agency, where for the past year I have been running Meta Ads campaigns for clients. That gives me a practical view of conversion and measurement, so I build pages with both in mind.
about.p3: I graduated from the Henry bootcamp and am currently studying Computer Engineering. I am looking for freelance projects: online stores, landing pages, business websites and custom web systems.
